Existing research versions can convert to the full market through direct adjustment without an AI call
Daily official Nasdaq directory; common equities/ADRs/REITs, class shares supported; no top-20/top-500 screening shortlist
Correct word-boundary filtering so United/Unity names and ordinary ADRs are not mistaken for units or preferred depositary shares
Adjusted Toss daily candles first, bounded inclusive pagination with duplicate/conflict/cursor checks; Yahoo history fallback

Live price factors and price filter use fresh Toss prices; volume factors use completed-session volume; equal target allocation follows exposure and per-position cap

Immutable full-universe exploratory backtest generations and research pins; no selected-today-only historical proxy; warmup validation

verification.integration: Real local HTTP server, actual spawned Toss adapters, actual data-worker orchestration, SQLite ledger, selection changes without a rule edit, scheduled expiry, stale decisions, cash/weight cap, backup and restore; external data and credentials synthetic
verification.ai: HTTP MockTransport and approved-research route fixtures only; zero real AI calls
verification.ui: Executable Node form submission, approval flow, conversion/adjustment rules and escaping; no live browser claim
verification.public_source: Official Nasdaq directory HTTP retrieval and class-share presence verified; not broker authentication

review.functionality: Direct source review, full regression suite, full-market selector and actual worker/ledger integration
review.performance: 6500 securities x 10 strategies x 5 factors x 320 history rows; streaming calculation 18.782s and peak RSS 135020544 bytes in the isolated process; excludes external HTTP and disk-history I/O
review.code_quality: Validated declarative strategy JSON, legacy defaults retained, bounded child networking, deterministic ticker ties, no generated code execution; git diff --check passed
review.security: Changed local-workstation paths reviewed directly; fixed public/provider URLs, bounded files/HTTP/IPC, no arbitrary endpoint input, no actual credential/AI/order use; not a whole-repository security scan

limits: No real Toss credentials were present; real broker authentication, production candle session labeling, live full-market coverage and days of uninterrupted live operation are not verified
Accelerated sessions and synthetic full-market performance are not real-time multi-day brokerage evidence
Supported strategies use the six implemented price/volume factors; news, financial statements and arbitrary intraday strategies are not implemented
New rebalances use the existing open+5 minute to close-15 minute window and calendar-day intervals
Freshness bound is 180 seconds; missing or unsupported securities are visibly excluded and retried; primary directory must be available
Selected/held corporate-action verification still depends on Yahoo; it is not optional in every execution path
Historical cache is 320 recent sessions; current-listing exploratory tests have survivorship bias and use prior-close/next-open execution
All-market initial preparation takes provider-dependent time; app and PC must remain running
Shared/public deployment, actual brokerage orders and OCI validation are outside this local exercise
